name: Darius
source: Pathfinder Adventure: A Fistful of Flowers

items.name: Wax Stirring Stick
items.description: This long piece of wood can aid in walking and deliver a mighty blow.

items.name: Singed Leather Apron and Clothing
items.description: Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

defensiveAbilities.name: Metabolize Mutagen
defensiveAbilities.description:
Darius metabolizes the power of an active mutagen to regain 2d6 Healing Damage Hit Points. If he does so (or if he's confronted by a stealthy party before he's had a chance to drink a mutagen), he loses his jaws and claw unarmed attacks, his bonus on Athletics checks decreases by 2, his AC increases by 1, and his Reflex save bonus increases by 2.

Effect: Active Mutagen

offensiveAbilities.name: Crystaline Mutation
offensiveAbilities.description: When Darius drinks any mutagen, his teeth and fingernails grow sharp crystalline edges.

offensiveAbilities.name: Spray Hot Wax
offensiveAbilities.description:
Darius sprays hot wax from his improvised wax sprayer in a 15ft Cone. All creatures in the area must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save. Scented candle homonoculi in the area take no damage, instead healing 2d6 Healing Damage damage. After using the hot wax cannon, Darius can't use it again until he takes two Interact actions while adjacent to the cauldron of bubbling wax to reload the sprayer.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes 2d6 Fire Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 3d6 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{3d6 fire damage plus 1d6 persistent fire damage}.

Critical Failure The creature takes 5d6 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{5d6 fire damage plus 2d6 persistent fire damage}.
